reason: I know the Yu Chun name and I crave cold naengmyeon on a hot day, so I would go once on this trip. I would order the $18.95 bowl and maybe mandoo, not the kalbi.
objection: The noodles alone won't fill me up, and adding a real main like kalbi at $38.95 puts one meal near $60 with tax and tip, which breaks my daily food budget.
